{{Quote|There is not now nor has there ever been any Imperial activity in this sector.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 93">[[Star Wars (1977) 93|''Star Wars'' (1977) 93]]</ref>}}
The '''Saijo sector''' was a sector located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], at the edge of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It included the [[Saijo system/Legends|system]] and [[Saijo/Legends|planet]] of the same name, as well as the [[Cantros system/Legends|Cantros system]] and [[Faldos system/Legends|Faldos system]].

Planets in this sector were attacked by [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] invaders in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].
